k-sym-HOLDERS.title: World record most holders $HOLDERS
k-sym-HOLDERS.sourceSays: Posts say $HOLDERS aims to be the most-held token on Solana, with creator fees going to buybacks and airdrops; an analysis bot calls the holder count dust-airdrop driven and the fee claim only partly confirmed.
k-sym-HOLDERS.reason: Posts of Nov 24 describe a stated public goal (world-record holder count) and an airdrop loop; a Larpcheck bot reply questions the claims. Most other posts are call-group shills; the story is unverified.
